links.comparator_used: individual top-performing models (single models) on external validation in TCGA-PAAD
links.outcome: External validation AUROC for classical vs basal-like subtype classification
links.effect: Top-3 ensemble external AUROC 0.961 vs 0.913-0.938 for top individual models
links.quote: Top models reached a cross-validated AUROC ≈ 0.96 and external AUROC 0.913-0.938 (top-3 ensemble 0.961); batch correction did not improve transfer, indicating minimal residual batch effect.
